Biology is the scientific study of life and living organisms.
Cell biology is the study of cells, not all of life.
Physiology studies the functions of organisms and their parts.
Botany is the study of plants.
A habitat is the place where a particular organism lives, not the whole inhabited part of Earth.
A population consists of members of one species in an area.
A community consists of populations of different species living together.
The biosphere is the part of Earth inhabited by living organisms and their communities.
Observation is the first step in solving a biological problem using the scientific method.
A hypothesis is proposed after observations and question formulation.
Deduction follows a hypothesis and predicts a result.
An experiment tests a hypothesis and comes after earlier steps.
A kingdom is a broad taxonomic category, not the basic unit.
A phylum is a broad taxonomic category, not the basic unit.
A genus groups closely related species.
Species is the basic unit of classification.
Diffusion is the net movement from higher concentration to lower concentration.
Osmosis is the movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane.
Passive transport moves substances down their concentration gradient without energy input.
Active transport can move molecules from lower to higher concentration using energy.
Carbohydrate synthesis is not the primary function of rough endoplasmic reticulum.
Ribosomes on rough endoplasmic reticulum synthesize proteins.
Smooth endoplasmic reticulum is mainly involved in lipid synthesis.
Vitamin synthesis is not the primary function of rough endoplasmic reticulum.
Mitosis does not normally produce eight daughter cells from one cell.
Mitosis does not normally produce six daughter cells from one cell.
Four daughter cells are typically produced by meiosis, not mitosis.
Mitosis produces two daughter cells.
Bile emulsifies fats but does not enzymatically break down starch.
Amylase breaks starch down into smaller carbohydrates.
Lipase digests fats, not starch.
Protease digests proteins, not starch.
Kinetic energy is energy of motion, not energy stored in food bonds.
Chemical energy stored in food bonds is a form of potential energy.
Heat is released during energy transformations but is not the energy stored in food bonds.
Solar energy is the original energy source for much food but is not the form stored in its bonds.

A thrombus is a blood clot formed within a blood vessel, not myocardial infarction itself.
An embolus is material that travels through the bloodstream and blocks a vessel.
The myocardium is the heart muscle, not the meaning of infarction.
Myocardial infarction is death of heart muscle tissue due to loss of blood supply.
Histology is the study of tissues.
Morphology is the study of form and structure.
Embryology is the study of embryo development.
Entomology is the study of insects.
Organelles are structures within cells, not groups of similar cells.
A tissue is a group of similar cells performing a common function.
An organ consists of different tissues working together.
An organ system consists of organs working together.
